verdict.rationale: IP India runs online e-filing and status services that hold applicant data, so data-residency choice is a fair privacy-posture question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions storage regions, residency options, or any user control over where data is stored. The pack covers only filing, search, tracking and publication pages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
